rules.name: even_ranks_only
rules.description: Only cards with an even rank (2,4,6,8,10,12).

rules.name: spades_only
rules.description: Only cards of the suit spades.

rules.name: face_red_number_black
rules.description: Face cards (11-13) must be red; number cards (1-10) must be black.
rules.code: return (card.rank >= 11 and card.color == "red") or (card.rank <= 10 and card.color == "black")

rules.name: strictly_increasing_ace_wrap
rules.description: Each card must have a rank strictly greater than the previous card. Ace may follow King. Any card may start the line.

rules.name: cyclic_suit_order
rules.description: Suits must repeat in the cyclic order hearts → spades → clubs → diamonds → hearts... Any card may start the line.
rules.code:
if not mainline:
    return True
cycle = ["hearts", "spades", "clubs", "diamonds"]
prev = mainline[-1].suit.suit_name
if prev not in cycle:
    return False
expected = cycle[(cycle.index(prev) + 1) % 4]
return card.suit.suit_name == expected

rules.name: color_or_parity_match
rules.description: Each card must share at least one property with the previous card: same color, or same parity. Any card may start the line.
rules.code:
if not mainline:
    return True
prev = mainline[-1]
same_color = card.color == prev.color
same_parity = (card.rank % 2) == (prev.rank % 2)
return same_color or same_parity

rules.name: alternating_suit_pairs
rules.description: Suits must appear in pairs: card 1 and 2 same suit, cards 3 and 4 same suit (different from 1 and 2), cards 5 and 6 same suit (different from 3 and 4), etc.
